adjudication.rationale: The diff widens `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to `DestinationCalendar[] | null` and EventManager now creates events per-destination (`createAllCalendarEvents` loops `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and calls `createEvent(...)`). However, in `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent`, `createAttendees`, `updateEvent`, and `deleteEvent` all destructure only the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];`) and use only that `externalId` as the calendar id. This means when multiple destination calendars are present, LarkCalendarService will still target only index 0 (likely the organizer) and ignore the others, leading to incorrect/silent behavior for multi-host destination calendars.
